title: SwitchInfo

SwitchInfo.isUnganged.title: isUnganged
SwitchInfo.isUnganged.description: If true, the switch is not ganged (i.e., a switch phase may be operated separately from other phases).

RecloserInfo.groundTripCapable.title: groundTripCapable
RecloserInfo.groundTripCapable.description: True if device has ground trip capability.

SwitchInfo.ratedInterruptingTime.title: ratedInterruptingTime
SwitchInfo.ratedInterruptingTime.description: Switch rated interrupting time in seconds.

Ravens.cimObjectType.title: cimObjectType
Ravens.cimObjectType.description: Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

RecloserInfo.recloseLockoutCount.title: recloseLockoutCount
RecloserInfo.recloseLockoutCount.description: Total number of phase reclose operations.

IdentifiedObject.description.title: description
IdentifiedObject.description.description: The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

OldSwitchInfo.loadBreak.title: loadBreak
OldSwitchInfo.loadBreak.description: True if switch has load breaking capabiity. Unless specified false, this is always assumed to be true for breakers and reclosers.

SwitchInfo.ratedImpulseWithstandVoltage.title: ratedImpulseWithstandVoltage
SwitchInfo.ratedImpulseWithstandVoltage.description: Rated impulse withstand voltage, also known as BIL (Basic Impulse Level).

SwitchInfo.isSinglePhase.title: isSinglePhase
SwitchInfo.isSinglePhase.description: If true, it is a single phase switch.

SwitchInfo.oilVolumePerTank.title: oilVolumePerTank
SwitchInfo.oilVolumePerTank.description: Volume of oil in each tank of bulk oil breaker.

SwitchInfo.gasWeightPerTank.title: gasWeightPerTank
SwitchInfo.gasWeightPerTank.description: Weight of gas in each tank of SF6 dead tank breaker.

OldSwitchInfo.remote.title: remote
OldSwitchInfo.remote.description: True if device is capable of being operated by remote control.

SwitchInfo.lowPressureAlarm.title: lowPressureAlarm
SwitchInfo.lowPressureAlarm.description: Gas or air pressure at or below which a low pressure alarm is generated.

RecloserInfo.groundTripNormalEnabled.title: groundTripNormalEnabled
RecloserInfo.groundTripNormalEnabled.description: True if normal status of ground trip is enabled.

OldSwitchInfo.dielectricStrength.title: dielectricStrength
OldSwitchInfo.dielectricStrength.description: The maximum rms voltage that may be applied across an open contact without breaking down the dielectric properties of the switch in the open position.

SwitchInfo.breakingCapacity.title: breakingCapacity
SwitchInfo.breakingCapacity.description: The maximum fault current a breaking device can break safely under prescribed conditions of use.

OldSwitchInfo.minimumCurrent.title: minimumCurrent
OldSwitchInfo.minimumCurrent.description: The lowest value of current that the switch can make, carry and break in uninterrupted duty at the rated voltage under specified operating conditions without suffering significant deterioration of its performance.

OldSwitchInfo.poleCount.title: poleCount
OldSwitchInfo.poleCount.description: Number of poles (i.e. of current carrying conductors that are switched).

SwitchInfo.lowPressureLockOut.title: lowPressureLockOut
SwitchInfo.lowPressureLockOut.description: Gas or air pressure below which the breaker will not open.

SwitchInfo.ratedFrequency.title: ratedFrequency
SwitchInfo.ratedFrequency.description: Frequency for which switch is rated.

OldSwitchInfo.makingCapacity.title: makingCapacity
OldSwitchInfo.makingCapacity.description: The highest value of current the switch can make at the rated voltage under specified operating conditions without suffering significant deterioration of its performance.

OldSwitchInfo.withstandCurrent.title: withstandCurrent
OldSwitchInfo.withstandCurrent.description: The highest value of current the switch can carry in the closed position at the rated voltage under specified operating conditions without suffering significant deterioration of its performance.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName.title: aliasName
IdentifiedObject.aliasName.description:
The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID.title: mRID
IdentifiedObject.mRID.description:
Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name.title: name
IdentifiedObject.name.description: The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
